_comment: Player + monster EXP/leveling curves for Omega Realm. Holds the monster EXP-reward curve and the player EXP-to-next-level curve, plus max level. The Rust omega-server (authoritative tick) and the Go API (XP->Glory persistence per ADR 0006) are the numeric authority; this client-side file is a mirror for display/tooling and the server wins on any disagreement. Governing GDD docs: docs/gdd/progression/EXP_monster_table.md and docs/gdd/progression/EXP_player_table.md (also docs/systems/PROGRESSION.md, docs/adr/0006-softcore-hardcore-glory-economy.md). ENCODED from those tables. TODO: confirm rounding mode matches server (round() in GDD vs server impl), confirm whether levels >50 monsters exist (table goes to 66 for high-tier biome bosses) and add a separate boss/monster level cap if needed.

monster_exp._comment: EXP a monster of a given level rewards on kill. ENCODED from EXP_monster_table.md.

player_exp_required._comment: EXP required to advance FROM the listed level to the next. ENCODED from EXP_player_table.md. MonsterEXP(level)=round(100*1.15^(level-1)).

player_stat_scaling._comment: Per-level stat growth is class-defined: stat(L) = base + per_lvl*(L-1), max level 50. The actual base/per_lvl numbers live per-class in client/data/classes/<id>.json (mirrored from the Rust server constants which are authoritative). Listed here only as the formula. See docs/gdd/classes/index.md.
